EF 协议架构组 Hegotá 立场
summary: EF 博客和 ethPandaOps 发布 Platåberget：面向社区的 Glamsterdam 测试网，计划运行数月，8 月 20 日在测试网上激活 Glamsterdam；博客提醒依赖硬编码最大 gas limit 的钱包、索引器和 gas 估算器会出问题。钱包基础设施方面，leekt 提交 frame 交易的钱包到 paymaster Web 服务标准和 `eth_estimateFrameTransactionGas`。EF 协议架构组发布 Hegotá 立场：FOCIL 是合适的头条，frame 交易应一同成为头条。

items.topic: frame 交易的钱包基础设施
items.title: 新 EIP：Frame Paymaster Web Service
items.note: （leekt）提交。为 EIP-8141 frame 交易定义钱包到 paymaster 的 Web 服务流程：`pm_getFramePaymasterStubData` 返回 gas 安全、由 paymaster 控制的 frame 和签名占位，钱包组装完整的未签名 FrameTx，并用 EIP-8141 的估算 RPC 估算。
items.title_en: New EIP: Frame Paymaster Web Service
items.note_en: (leekt), submitted. It defines a wallet-to-paymaster web service flow for EIP-8141 frame transactions: `pm_getFramePaymasterStubData` returns gas-safe, paymaster-controlled frame and signature stubs, the wallet assembles the complete unsigned FrameTx and estimates it with the EIP-8141 estimation RPC.

items.topic: frame 交易的钱包基础设施
items.title: EIP-8141：定义 FrameTx gas 估算 RPC
items.note: （leekt）提交。直接在 EIP-8141 中定义 `eth_estimateFrameTransactionGas`，因为每个 frame 需要独立的执行和状态 gas 上限；`null` 上限作为估算目标，非空上限作为调用方给定的上限，返回固有 gas 和逐 frame 上限，并要求以返回值做一次确认执行。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: define a FrameTx gas estimation RPC
items.note_en: (leekt), submitted. It defines `eth_estimateFrameTransactionGas` directly in EIP-8141 because each frame needs independent execution and state gas limits; `null` limits are estimation targets and non-null limits are caller-supplied caps, the call returns intrinsic gas plus per-frame limits, and it requires a confirmation execution with exactly the returned limits.

items.title: EF 博客：宣布 Platåberget 测试网
items.note: ethPandaOps：Platåberget 是面向 Glamsterdam 的测试网 19:47。博客说明：它不同于短命的 devnet，计划运行数月；验证者集合规模小但公开可加入，创世集合由公开存款引导；测试网上的 Glamsterdam 分叉定于 8 月 20 日；gas 重定价会影响所有钱包、索引器和 gas 估算器，依赖硬编码最大 gas limit 的工具会出问题。
items.title_en: EF blog: announcing the Platåberget testnet
items.note_en: EthPandaOps: Platåberget is our Glamsterdam-focused testnet, 19:47. Per the blog, unlike short-lived devnets it is meant to run for a few months; the validator set is small but publicly joinable, with genesis bootstrapped from public deposits; the Glamsterdam fork on the testnet is scheduled for August 20; and the gas repricings touch every wallet, indexer and gas estimator, so tools that rely on a hardcapped maximum gas limit will break.

summary_en: The EF blog and ethPandaOps announced Platåberget, a community-facing Glamsterdam testnet meant to run for months, with Glamsterdam activating on it on August 20; the blog warns that wallets, indexers and gas estimators relying on a hardcapped maximum gas limit will break. On wallet infrastructure, leekt submitted a wallet-to-paymaster web service standard for frame transactions and `eth_estimateFrameTransactionGas`. EF Protocol Architecture published its Hegotá view: FOCIL is the right headliner and frame transactions should join it.
